title: Clinical Sales Executive
description:
* Bengaluru, INDIA, India
* Not Remote
* Sales
* JOB218667

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function:**
  
Intuitive Surgical is widely considered the most exciting medical device company in the world today. Surgeons worldwide are changing the way surgery is performed by utilizing our robotic surgical device, the *da Vinci®* Surgical System, to enhance their surgical precision and greatly improve patient benefits. The Clinical Sales Associate will help maximize the utilization of installed *da Vinci®* Surgical Systems.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Work with the Clinical Sales Manager to develop a strategy to drive utilization of the *daVinci®* Surgical System
* Become a *da Vinci®* Surgery expert across all primary surgical specialties in order to support the development of surgical robotics programs in the assigned territory
* Support field efforts to achieve quarterly sales goals
* Support regional Sales and Marketing development events that create system awareness and procedure adoption
* Train and develop OR staff to be facile in pre, intra and postoperative system management.
* Develop a da Vinci® Surgery plan for each surgical team to insure they are capable of using the system independently within a reasonable time frame.
* Drive utilization of the da Vinci® system by working with surgical teams to select appropriate procedure applications.
* Drive continuous expansion of the user base by working with key hospital staff and surgeon thought leaders to develop a qualified lead funnel
* Drive sales of instruments and accessories
* Responsibly manage administrative tasks; reporting of sales/procedures, outcomes of sales activities, submission of expense reports, etc.

### **Qualifications**

**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 6-10 years prior sales experience in medical devices space is required
* Ability to excel in a high-energy, fast-paced environment
* Excellent interpersonal skills and persuasive communication skills
* Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team
* Ability to travel up to 50%
* Lead surgical teams through training sessions, helping them understand system operations, OR integration and da Vinci® Surgery applications
* Be a resource to the surgical team, providing guidance and insight on the use of the daVinci® Surgical System

### **Additional Information**

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Role:** Business Development Associate  
**Company:** Kavora Tech Groups  
**Qualification:** Any Degree  
**Location:** Bengaluru

ABOUT KAVORA TECH GROUPS

Kavora Tech Groups is a next-generation technology upskilling and career transformation platform designed for students, graduates, and working professionals aiming to thrive in the ever-evolving tech industry.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by providing hands-on training, mentorship, and real-world problem-solving opportunities.

At Kavora Tech Groups, we believe that talent, when nurtured with the right resources and guidance, can unlock limitless career opportunities. Our structured ecosystem ensures that learners not only gain valuable technical knowledge but also develop the confidence and skill set needed to create a meaningful impact in the tech world.

Our learners are guided and mentored by industry veterans and tech leaders from globally recognized organizations such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Netflix, and Infosys, among others.

Each program is carefully curated and vetted by experts, ensuring that the curriculum remains aligned with industry needs and prepares professionals for both cutting-edge innovation and high-growth career paths.

What We Offer

* A comprehensive curriculum focusing on Software Development, Data Structures, Algorithms, System Design, AI, and Cloud Technologies.
* Personalized one-to-one mentorship with tech leaders.
* Live instructor-led classes, mock interviews, coding challenges, and career counseling.
* Access to the Kavora Tech Groups Community, a dynamic network of learners, mentors, and alumni collaborating on knowledge-sharing, opportunities, and referrals.
* Real-world industry projects to build portfolios that stand out.

VISION & MISSION

We are on a mission to empower **1 million+ learners in the next decade**, transforming them into world-class tech professionals capable of contributing meaningfully to innovation and solving pressing global challenges.

DIFFERENTIATORS

What sets Kavora Tech Groups apart is our commitment to:

* **Deep Mentorship:** Personalized guidance tailored to each learner’s pace and career goals.
* **Industry Readiness:** We go beyond academics to ensure our learners are job-ready for the toughest interviews and challenging tech scenarios.
* **Community for Life:** Our alumni and mentor community is committed to giving back, helping learners accelerate career growth with strong peer and leadership support.

Kavora Tech Groups is steadily becoming one of the most trusted names in tech education and career development — a platform where ambition meets opportunity.

JOB OPENING

**Position:** Business Development Associate  
**Experience:** Freshers Welcome  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**CTC:** 4 LPA + 3 LPA (Fixed + Variable)  
**Probation Period:** 2 Months  
**Stipend During Probation:** ₹17,000/- (Up to ₹30,000/- as Variable)  
**Language Preference:** Tamil, Telugu, Kannada  
**Requirement:** Must own a laptop and have a stable internet connection

ABOUT THE ROLE

Kavora Tech Groups is seeking energetic and motivated Business Development Associates to join our dynamic team. This entry-level role is ideal for freshers looking to build a career in sales and business growth within the education technology sector.

You will play a key role in driving our business by identifying opportunities, building client relationships, and contributing to revenue growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Conduct market research and identify potential clients and new business opportunities.
* Initiate outreach through cold calling, emails, and other channels to generate leads.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospective and existing clients to increase business reach.
* Assist in developing and executing sales and marketing strategies aligned with business goals.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and delivery to clients.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions and sales pipeline within CRM systems.
* Support senior business development and sales managers in closing deals and creating proposals.
* Track performance metrics and help optimize outreach strategies for better conversions.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

* Freshers are welcome to apply; prior experience in sales or business development is a plus.
* Strong communication skills in English and one or more of Tamil, Telugu, or Kannada.
* Self-motivated and target-driven with excellent time management skills.
* Basic understanding of CRM tools and MS Office applications.
* Ability to build rapport, influence decision-making, and manage client relationships effectively.
* Team player with a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced startup environment.

BENEFITS

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere.
* Hands-on experience in the growing EdTech sector.
* Regular training and development programs to enhance your skill set.
* Work with a passionate team dedicated to empowering learners and making an impact.

**Job Title: Trade and Transaction Operator**

**Corporate Title: NCT**

**Location: Bangalore, India**

**Role Description**

* Trust & Agency Services (TAS) having over 1,500 clients ranging from multi-national corporations to banks and financial institutions, hedge funds, asset managers and supranational agencies around the world. TAS Ops support all types of transactions in the debt capital markets – from conventional to structured debt products, project finance, REITS, and Islamic finance – and services for escrows, restructurings and exchanges, loan agency and document custody.
* The Trade and/or Transaction Associate strives to be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with internal partners and/or external clients (as appropriate) and within the wider market to improve market practices and platforms. The Trade and/or Transaction Associate builds and manages partnerships between internal businesses to ensure that the bank’s business objectives are delivered, comply with operational control, external regulation and continue to improve the bank’s technology platforms, as appropriate. Where relevant, they focus on new business initiatives and working as a team to ensure full front-to-back operational readiness for products ranging from high-volume vanilla trading through to highly complex structured transactions.
* Regulatory change and an ever-evolving business environment mean that the Trade and/or Transaction Associate must continually provide input and creative innovative solutions to deliver efficiencies and protect the bank and its shareholders.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* As an Associate (Operations Manager), you are expected to achieve success by leading yourself, your team and the business
* Perform internal controls and support the daily production.
* Should be able lead the daily calls with business/onshore understand and articulate to requirements from the onshore for the smooth course of the process
* Responsible for responding to ad-hoc issues or client queries on a timely basis, ensuring all communications have been responded to before end of day.
* Ensure process documentation is relevant and updated regularly for your process to audit standards.
* Coach, Mentor, Develop, Onboard and provide career development planning and opportunities to the team members
* Ensure Mandatory Compliance Courses are completed on time by you and your team
* Identify and reward the performers through various rewards and recognition programs

**Your skills and experience**

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Good written & verbal English skills. Ability to converse clearly with internal staff via telephone and using written communication.
* Good typing speed with accuracy, MS Office (especially MS excel)
* Ability to provide high transaction productivity and high level of attention to detail.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of key elements of document review
* Ability to work effectively on a team
* Able to operate calmly and efficiently in a high volume, intense atmosphere that maintains a very low margin of error

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

title: Associate Project Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Project Lead Engineer

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your knowledge by applying basic design thinking/design best practices concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Energy Division in Bangalore- India Region. Main stakeholders include Project Lead Engineers, DCS/Automation Engineering Teams, Customers & End Users, Commissioning & Site Operations Teams, and Pharma/Chemical Plant Stakeholders.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Support the development, engineering, configuration, and implementation of DCS projects, working closely with lead engineers to deliver solutions that meet project requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Develop, configure, customize, and test DCS applications, including system validation, loop checks, functional testing, and troubleshooting activities to ensure reliable and efficient system performance.
* Perform site surveys, standard engineering calculations, data analysis, and basic design activities, while preparing project documentation, technical reports, and as-built deliverables within the assigned scope.
* Assist in the installation, integration, commissioning, and startup of DCS systems at customer sites, collaborating with project teams, contractors, and customers to resolve technical issues and support effective project execution and handover.
* Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, engineering workshops, and project review sessions, contributing to effective communication, continuous improvement initiatives, and the timely delivery of project milestones.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* You have a Diploma or Degree in engineering, electrical, Electronics, EEC, Instrumentation or chemical engineering.
* You have 2 to 5 years of experience in industrial automation DCS commissioning in process automation industry.
* You enjoy working with industrial automation in the pharma and chemicals market.
* You possess enhanced knowledge of 800xA.
* You are comfortable communicating verbally and in writing in English.

**More about us:**

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

title: Payment Lifecycle Associate I
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Join a team shaping the future of digital payments and drive your professional growth. Unlock your potential and make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced and innovative environment.  
  
As a Payment Lifecycle Associate I within Payments Operations, you will enhance our payment operations framework by streamlining processes, implementing new technologies, and developing operational functions, while managing payment processing across various products to ensure smooth fund transfers and reconcile purchase and sales options, futures, or securities. Leveraging your proficiency in automation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud awareness, you will ensure the security and efficiency of our payment lifecycle. Your ability to manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and handle conflicts will drive mutually beneficial outcomes, while your strategic planning skills will guide our direction and resource allocation decisions. Additionally, your proficiency in AI/ML will be utilized to solve complex problems and enhance processes, applying your knowledge in market product and process improvement to optimize our operations.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Review and process payments across various products, ensuring accurate and timely fund transfers, while resolving production or quality issues and escalating delays to management and stakeholders.
* Manage and deliver moderately complex payment lifecycle projects, contributing to client experience, transformation initiatives, and process optimization.
* Lead or contribute to operational initiatives, providing expertise in automation, process re-engineering, risk management, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud opportunities.
* Conduct research and data analysis to resolve non-routine payment lifecycle issues, including cash, trade, merchant, or commercial card transactions, and fraud detection.
* Apply knowledge of systems architecture and automation technologies to identify inefficiencies, improve quality, and enhance customer experience, while defining project requirements and metrics.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders and teams to drive mutually beneficial outcomes, ensure smooth operations, and participate in fraud prevention and talent development.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Demonstrated ability in operations leadership or management within payments, with at least two years of experience, showcasing advanced knowledge of global payment processing operations, products, and systems architecture to effectively support efficiency and change management.
* Demonstrates self-reliance and a proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to navigate dynamic environments and shifting workloads across complex products.
* Proficient in data analysis techniques, capable of interpreting and communicating insights to inform decision-making with senior stakeholders.
* Applies a commercial and growth mindset to adapt to fast-paced operations and new business initiatives, leveraging strong interpersonal skills to optimize relationships and collaboration.
* Understands cybersecurity controls and anti-fraud strategies to protect information and systems, with familiarity in continuous improvement methodologies and design thinking techniques.
* Proficient in using automation technologies to optimize payments processing, with a proven track record in enhancing customer experience throughout the customer journey.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Knowledge of ISO or Swift message processing or management.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

**ABOUT US**

Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Associate Manager
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Assistant Manager – Full Stack Developer, R&D Technology**

  
  

**About C5i**

C5i is a global AI, Analytics and Data company that helps organizations turn complex business challenges into measurable impact. We combine advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, data engineering and deep industry expertise — delivered by multidisciplinary teams across technology, data science, analytics and consulting — to enable faster, better decision-making.

With a strong focus on innovation, C5i builds proprietary AI-powered solutions, accelerators and platforms, and works with leading global organizations across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Banking, Retail, Consumer Goods, Technology, Media and Manufacturing to scale AI and analytics into meaningful business outcomes.

  
  

**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Full Stack Developer to join C5i's technology team on a strategic engagement with a leading global pharmaceutical client. The role sits within a central technology capability supporting R&D and Clinical Operations, building modern, scalable applications in React and Next.js, and using Generative AI / AI-assisted development (“vibe coding”) to accelerate delivery.

You'll work closely with C5i and client stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into high-quality, production-ready applications — a role suited to someone who enjoys hands-on building, modern development practices, experimenting with AI-powered coding tools, and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications supporting R&D and Clinical Operations use cases.
* Build responsive, scalable front-end interfaces using React and Next.js, and backend services and APIs using Next.js and related modern web technologies.
* Design integrations, authentication and application services around REST APIs.
Work with enterprise data sources such as Databricks and Snowflake via pre-built queries, APIs or data services,* ing basic SQL and data/analytics understanding.
* Collaborate with C5i teams and client stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into functional applications.
* Leverage GenAI-assisted development (“vibe coding”) — including effective prompt engineering, context management and token optimization — to accelerate prototyping and delivery.
* Review, validate, debug and optimize AI-generated code to ensure it meets production-quality engineering standards.
* Participate across the full lifecycle: solution design, development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Troubleshoot application and integration issues across frontend, backend and data-consumption layers.
* Work in an agile environment with frequent/weekly releases, collaborating with globally distributed C5i and client teams, including teams in UK/European time zones.

**Required Skills & Experience**
